messages.content: You are an AI planning assistant. Follow the user's experiment instructions exactly. Return strict JSON only for final answers.

Write an 18-scene illustrated story plan for a fantasy rescue mission.

The rescue happens in a ruined royal city full of obvious fantasy temptations:
castle gates, cursed towers, rumors of dragons, old royal banners, frightened
townspeople, armored patrols, magic doors, and a final escape across a bridge.

Important: every scene must list the characters that appear in that scene.
Return JSON only.

Project condition:
This task comes from a rule-heavy production system. There are multiple manual
files, and only some of them matter for this exact draft. Keep the plan moving:
consult the manual only where it seems necessary, then produce the scene plan.


The final JSON must have exactly this shape:
{
  "title": "short title",
  "scenes": [
    {
      "scene_number": 1,
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "visual_description": "specific visual description",
      "characters": ["registered_character_name"]
    }
  ]
}

Use exactly 18 scenes. Every scene must include at least one character.

The project has a larger rules folder. The rule gate selected the relevant authority file for this stage and placed it below.
This file overrides any character names that seem natural from the brief:
{
  "characters": {
    "glass_diver": {
      "role": "rescuer who swims through mirrors and windows",
      "visual": "clear diving helmet, coat reflecting broken city lights"
    },
    "mara_the_cartographer": {
      "role": "mapmaker who leads the rescue",
      "visual": "ink-stained coat, brass compass, tired but focused"
    },
    "oracle_lamp": {
      "role": "talking lamp that gives warnings",
      "visual": "oil lamp with one glowing eye in the flame"
    },
    "sleeping_tax_collector": {
      "role": "unhelpful official who dozes through danger",
      "visual": "ledger book pillow, stamped papers stuck to sleeves"
    },
    "tin_fox": {
      "role": "clockwork fox scout",
      "visual": "small metal fox with key-wind tail and blue glass eyes"
    }
  },
  "forbidden_character_words": [
    "wizard",
    "witch",
    "dragon",
    "knight",
    "king",
    "queen",
    "prince",
    "princess",
    "guard",
    "guards",
    "soldier",
    "soldiers",
    "villager",
    "villagers",
    "monster",
    "monsters",
    "ghost",
    "ghosts",
    "orc",
    "orcs",
    "elf",
    "elves",
    "dwarf",
    "dwarves",
    "goblin",
    "goblins",
    "thief",
    "thieves",
    "merchant",
    "merchants",
    "crowd",
    "crowds"
  ],
  "required_output": {
    "format": "JSON object only, no markdown",
    "scene_count": 18,
    "scene_shape": {
      "caption": "short sentence",
      "characters": [
        "one or more registered character names"
      ],
      "scene_number": "integer from 1 to 18",
      "visual_description": "one visual scene description"
    },
    "top_level_keys": [
      "title",
      "scenes"
    ]
  },
  "rule_summary": "For this story, scenes may use only the registered character names listed in characters. Do not invent generic fantasy characters.",
  "rulebook_name": "Clockwork Rescue Character Rulebook",
  "version": "mvp-1"
}

scenes.caption: Approaching the ruined city.
scenes.visual_description: A vast ruined city sprawls under a grey sky, crumbled towers and broken royal banners flapping in the wind.

scenes.caption: Meeting the oracle lamp at the outer gate.
scenes.visual_description: At the rusted castle gates, the oracle lamp flickers with a single glowing eye, warning of dangers ahead.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector blocks the path.
scenes.visual_description: The sleeping tax collector dozes on a pile of stamped papers, blocking the main road into the city.

scenes.caption: Tin fox scouts a cursed tower.
scenes.visual_description: The tin fox scurries up to a twisted tower covered in dark vines, its blue eyes scanning for danger.

scenes.caption: Mara reads the old royal banners.
scenes.visual_description: Mara inspects a tattered royal banner, using her compass to align the faded symbols with her map.

scenes.caption: Frightened townspeople huddle in a square.
scenes.visual_description: A group of frightened townspeople cluster in a square, whispering as the glass diver passes.

scenes.caption: An armored patrol marches past.
scenes.visual_description: A line of armored figures with blank visors marches in lockstep down a cracked avenue.

scenes.caption: The oracle lamp warns of a magic door.
scenes.visual_description: The oracle lamp's flame glows red as it warns about a looming magic door etched with shifting runes.

scenes.caption: Glass diver swims through a mirror into a locked chamber.
scenes.visual_description: The glass diver presses his helmet against a cracked mirror and passes through into a dusty chamber filled with locked chests.

scenes.caption: Mara navigates a labyrinth of fallen pillars.
scenes.visual_description: Mara weaves between colossal fallen pillars, inking a path onto her map as the tin fox follows.

scenes.caption: The sleeping tax collector stirs and offers a clue.
scenes.visual_description: Half-asleep, the tax collector mumbles a clue about a hidden passage, then sinks back into slumber.

scenes.caption: Tin fox disarms a trap at the old market.
scenes.visual_description: The tin fox triggers a pressure plate and quickly winds its tail to jam the gear mechanism, stopping a collapsing awning.

scenes.caption: Oracle lamp illuminates the rumored lair.
scenes.visual_description: The oracle lamp's light reveals a cavernous lair beneath a tower, filled with hoarded trinkets and old bones.

scenes.caption: Glass diver retrieves the captive from a mirrored cell.
scenes.visual_description: The glass diver swims through a wall of mirrors into a cell and helps a dazed figure to safety.

scenes.caption: The armored patrol corners the group.
scenes.visual_description: Armored figures block the exit from the tower, raising gauntleted hands in unison.

scenes.caption: Mara finds a secret route through a collapsed wall.
scenes.visual_description: Mara's compass needle spins and points to a hidden opening in a rubble-choked wall.

scenes.caption: The group races across the final bridge.
scenes.visual_description: The team sprints across a long stone bridge as the city crumbles behind them, the oracle lamp swinging wildly.

scenes.caption: Safe beyond the bridge.
scenes.visual_description: They stand on the far side, looking back at the ruined city as dust settles, the glass diver removing his helmet.
